If all samples have the same duration and are in presentation order, you can pass a single `CMSampleTimingInfo` struct with duration set to the duration of one sample, `presentationTimeStamp` set to the presentation time of the numerically earliest sample, and `decodeTimeStamp` set to `kCMTimeInvalid`.
